data.title: Community Initiative in Makkah Raises Diabetes Awareness, Encourages Physical Activity
data.content:
Makkah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Al-Naseem Walkway in Makkah hosted a community initiative to raise awareness of diabetes and promote physical activity, coinciding with World Diabetes Day. The event brought together several government, health, sports, and volunteer organizations to raise awareness of the importance of early diabetes detection and encourage community members to engage in physical activity and adopt healthy lifestyles.
    The event featured sports and awareness activities, with health specialists and volunteers providing guidance on diabetes prevention, the importance of regular health screenings, and the role of healthy nutrition and physical activity in reducing risk factors associated with chronic diseases.
    The initiative builds on ongoing awareness efforts to promote preventive healthcare, encourage early detection, and strengthen community partnerships among the health, sports, and volunteer sectors. These efforts aim to build a more health-conscious society that recognizes the importance of healthy daily habits, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
